name: Octadesk Plus | Validação, catálogos e token (a cada minuto)

parameters.query: select octaplus.gravar_catalogos(x) from (select $1::jsonb as x) s where x is not null
select octaplus.gravar_jwt(t, e) from (select $1::text as t, $2::timestamptz as e) s where t is not null

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Validar, sincronizar e renovar token').first().json.jwt?.token ?? null, $('Validar, sincronizar e renovar token').first().json.jwt?.expira_em ?? null] }}
